messages:
Sami: Quick life update: got promoted to Staff Eng today and also (surprise) were expecting a baby in January! :tada: :baby: Low-key overwhelmed. Would love a tiny team fika to celebrate 1 Tue at 4pm? No gifts, just vibes.
Lee: WHOA congrats times two!! :confetti_ball: :heart_eyes: Tue 4pm works for me. I can bring cookies.
Priya: This is the best news!! Congrats Sami!! Ill bring card and some non-dairy milk. :sparkling_heart:
Marco: Amazing!! Staff Eng + baby = legend status. I can grab savory snacks. Also can we do a quick group photo for the card?
Tess: congrats Sami!! so happy for you. Tue 4 sounds perfect. Ill bring a tiny plant (no pressure). :seedling:
Amal: Huge congrats!! Ill DJ the playlist. Also vote check: :cake: cake, :cookie: cookies, :croissant: pastries?
Lee: :cookie:
Priya: :cake:
Marco: :croissant:
Sami: I vote cookies but honestly everything sounds amazing. Also if anyone wants to help keep it low-key surprise-y for me let Priya know :)
party-bot: Reminder created: "Sami double-win fika" at 1769997600 (Tue 16:00) 1 RSVP reactions so far. React to RSVP by EOD Monday.
Sami: Thanks friends 1 reading all these messages is making me tear up. Will happily accept carbs and vibes. :pray:
